in_marathi.name: Krishana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krishana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Krishna is an avatar of Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. The name Krishana is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘krit’ meaning ‘to do’ and ‘shana’ meaning ‘to distribute’. The name symbolizes the goddess of wealth and prosperity, who distributes the fruits of one's labor. Krishna is also known for his mischievous nature and playful pranks.
